strings.en:
{0c:5248502b591000}{0b:08}【 Haughty Knight 】{0b:09}
Nnnnrgh!!{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Nnnnrgh!!
Judging by the crest on that cloak, you belong to Duke Durer's own order, [1]the Red Lion Knights. // A centurion by rank, I would guess...
The Red Lion Knights!? The ones who slaughtered tens of thousands of citizens in South Asroit!? // [1]Kill him!! They killed even women and children without mercy. No reason to let him live!!
Please wait. There is more I wish to ask. // [1]The Red Lion Knights should currently be deployed along the coast of the Iradeya Sea... So why are they inside the ruins?
C-could it be the town's connected to the outside? Can we get out!?
Heh heh, too bad. // We were summoned to this place by an angel. I know no way back.
An angel...?

Yes. As we marched, a beautiful angel descended before us. // And the angel spoke directly into our hearts... // 'Holy warriors, slay those who defy God.' 'Guard the gate to the Land of Origin.' // When we came to, we were in that place.
Holy warriors, huh? Don't make me laugh!!
We are knights blessed by God. Not one of you apostates shall pass through that 'Gate'.
W-w-what do we do...

strings.en:
{0c:52ff09ff112b5b1000}{1c:21}{0b:08}【 Noel 】{0b:09}
What are you so rattled about?{0c:2b5b09fe}
strings.tl: What are you so rattled about?
Well, y'know, that strong order of knights, or whatever it's called, is lying in wait, right? // Then we can't go on.
Why not drop your inferiority complex about nobles already? // Even if there were a hundred of them, you as you are now could beat them easily, all by yourself.
This is bad... If knights are lyin' in wait, we can't go on...
Hey, hey, drop that peasant mindset already. // Knights or whatever, the way we are now, even a hundred of 'em'd be easy pickin's.
Y-yeah, you're right. Pathetic. Hear 'knight' or 'noble' and I still start shakin'.

We know well your ill repute. // However, as they say, even if a thousand of you gathered, you could not defeat us. // [1]This is no vanity. That is how great the gap in strength between us is.
You think to threaten me? Hmph, a clumsy lie.

strings.en:
{0c:52ff31ff39}{1c:1a}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
Believe it or not, as you please.{1a}But to the people of this town, the
monsters rampaging outside are mere
small fry for newcomer adventurers.{1a}Every day we fight monsters many times
stronger than those you have fought. In
terms of sheer fighting strength, you
have no chance of winning.{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Believe it or not, as you please. // But to the people of this town, the monsters rampaging outside are mere small fry for newcomer adventurers. // Every day we fight monsters many times stronger than those you have fought. In terms of sheer fighting strength, you have no chance of winning.

Hmph, you are all bluster. But do not take us lightly. // Those the angel summoned are five hundred elites of the Alexis Division, the mightiest among the Red Lion Knights! // We shall scatter the likes of you with a single blow!
Alexis...? If I recall, the third son of Duke Durer. The Red Lion Knights' second-in-command, I believe...
Oh? You are well informed, for a commoner. // If you surrender, I might intercede with Alexis-sama on your behalf.
Hey, hey, you're the prisoner here, fella. 'Might intercede', my ass. Keep quiet like a prisoner oughta! // [1]Qumran, I'm takin' him away now. Ain't no use talkin' to him any more.
Yes.
Aww, and here I thought we could finally get out.
Tch, and here I thought we could finally get out.

Yeah. So what do we do? // They're lying in wait on the way to this 'Land of Origin', right? Then we're gonna run into them for sure. // [1]Are we okay to fight them? You'd never talk those guys into anything.
Yeah, that's right. // They're lyin' in wait on the way to the 'Land of Origin', so a clash can't be avoided. // And that kind ain't ever gonna listen to us talkin' 'em down.

Q-Qumran, I'm sorry!

No! Fatum took him! He's headin' for the ruins right now!!
